target_customer: Support, training and marketing teams at software companies that document product usage
problem: Writing step by step guides with screenshots is slow. Gluetrail turned one screen and audio recording into articles and videos and published them to other platforms.

founders.name: Anne-Charlotte Chauvet
founders.background_notes: YC page says she led Revenue Operations at Algolia and has over ten years in RevOps at B2B SaaS companies.

founders.name: Baptiste Coquelle
founders.background_notes: YC page says he joined Algolia early and worked on data automation, pipelines and analytics.

competitors.name: Scribe
competitors.what: Tool that records workflows and generates step by step guides
competitors.funding_then: 30 million dollars raised in 2021 including a Series A

technical_complexity.rationale: A Chrome extension capturing clicks and audio, plus an LLM to write articles and connectors to Notion, Zendesk and others, is standard engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Scribe and Tango already offered similar capture tools, and the added AI writing was easy to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source says these rivals acted against Gluetrail; Scribe later raised a 75 million dollar Series C in November 2025.

market_need_then: The YC description cites no customer numbers; the broader category was funded, with Scribe raising 30 million dollars in 2021.

branding.domain_note: Used gluetrail.com; no acquisition story found.

brand_strength.rationale: A coined compound that is easy to spell and distinct, but the branding search returned no press or community about it.

pivots.from: No-code SaaS for building internal tools (per the YC launch post)
pivots.to: Chrome extension that creates step by step articles from recordings
pivots.why: Not stated; the YC page shows both descriptions without explaining the relation.

outcome_analysis: The cause of Gluetrail ending is not public. The YC page marks it Inactive, and its two former Algolia founders pitched a documentation tool in a category where Scribe had raised 30 million dollars in 2021. No source gives revenue, users or a shutdown post, so no failure factor is assigned. The earlier internal tools description suggests the team changed product, but dates are not stated.
notes: gluetrail.com returned HTTP 503, so site status is unverified. The 500K pre-seed rests on Seedtable and VCBacked; Standout adds Kima Ventures as an investor and Latka says bootstrapped, which conflicts. The Scribe source is dated before the batch. Guidde is not listed because no dated source was found. The searches for outcome returned unrelated Chrome extension news.
